newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel prices fall.

text.p: Indian copper prices on Tuesday suffered a setback while nickel also saw losses. Other base metals were steady in a narrow price band, dealers said.

Copper slid by 50 rupees at 13,700 rupees per quintal as demand resistance at the higher level prompted profit-taking following reports of a slide in world prices. Copper was up by 150 rupees per quintal on Monday.
Nickel fell by 200 rupees at 36,400 rupees per quintal as sliding global prices prompted fresh unloading by local stockists. Nickel was down by 600 rupees per quintal last week.

Zinc was steady at 8,100 rupees per quintal after gaining 100 rupees on Monday while lead was quiet at 4,100 rupees per quintal after losing 50 rupees on Monday. Tin was steady at 31,200 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees last week.
"Aluminium was steady at 7,700 rupees per quintal but undertone was firm on expectation that local producers may hike selling prices," one broker said.
